newsitem.title: UK: Record sugar, wheat futures in LIFFE April volume.
newsitem.headline: Record sugar, wheat futures in LIFFE April volume.

text.p: White sugar and wheat both set monthly turnover records on the London International Financial Futures Exchange (LIFFE) in April, a LIFFE report showed.

In white sugar, 71,059 contracts were traded compared with the previous record of 64,620 contracts in April 1996, it said. The April 1997 figure was sharply higher than that for March, when 23,912 contracts were traded.
LIFFE's wheat contract saw 16,606 contracts traded during the month after the previous record of 15,183 contracts, again set in April 1996. The March 1997 figure was 11,849 contracts.
Total commodity futures turnover for April 1997 reached 399,547 contracts after 332,179 in March and 400,282 in April 1996.

But cocoa futures, as usual, were the most actively traded item and turnover rose slightly to 178,232 contracts from 171,804 in March. Options volume was light at 1,151 contracts after 3,622 in the previous month.
In robusta coffee, the second most active futures contract, volume rose to 124,180 contracts in April from 118,200 in March.
Coffee took the bulk of the monthly options volume with 13,025 contracts after 12,228 in March.
